adopt: Write one sensitive action to it and then try to remove the record.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
An audit log you can silently delete from is decoration. Most are. The property that matters is not "it records" but "a missing record is visible".

Install
pip install awdit

Commands
  awdit

Quick start
  pip install awdit

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awdit/
synopsis: An append-only audit trail whose gaps are DETECTABLE.
